authority: experiment-owner direction to continue the replicate queue without per-run approval

what_was_attempted.why_this_cell: Its single replicate reads -55.1%, the second largest effect in the corpus and the only untested claim above 2x over control noise. Four of five thinner claims did not survive a second replicate, so this was the last chance to show that any margin is trustworthy at n=1.

cause.finding: task-01 exceeded the 7200s per-task budget having reached step 14. Provider slowness, not quota and not credentials.
cause.evidence: Zero AI_APICallError and zero level=ERROR entries in the lane's OpenCode log. The credential materialised on 2026-10-02 is valid to 2026-10-09 and the throughput probe returned 322 words in 10s shortly before launch.
cause.context: This is the same signature as the Fastify failures of 09-24 through 09-26: the lane streams without error and is simply too slow to finish a task. It is the first failure since the credential was fixed, so it is not a recurrence of the auth defect.

disclosed_spend.note: Real but unquantifiable. The adapter writes normalized events at task completion and the kill left a zero-byte event file, so no step_finish telemetry survives to sum. Disclosed as unmeasurable rather than as zero.

decision: Not retried immediately. Under the standing rule one failure is diagnosed and disclosed rather than repeated; two consecutive failures in the same shape stop the queue. The next launch moves to Serena on Beets, which is both the next queue item and a test of whether this is specific to the Fastify lane, where every slowness failure in this study has occurred.
open_question_still_open: Whether any single-replicate margin is trustworthy. The corpus has tested 1.1x through 1.6x and retracted four of five; 2.3x remains unmeasured.
